verdict.rationale: Greptile documents custom rules for team-specific issues and repository standards via greptile.json, scoped by directory, applied in AI reviews that run on every PR [greptile-docs-21, greptile-docs-45, greptile-docs-48, greptile-docs-1]. It also imports natural-language rule files such as AGENTS.md and Claude.md [greptile-docs-35, greptile-docs-31]. However, these rules surface as review comments and an overall 0-5 merge score, not as named, per-rule pass/fail pre-merge checks [greptile-docs-16, greptile-docs-37]. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that rules are written in plain language, per-rule pass/fail check status that gates merge, documented examples like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths', and independent hands-on corroboration.
